mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points within one month signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS are both below 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 109.0) during supply shock regimes signals production constraints that reduce corporate margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 109.0.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) strengthens consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as labor market conditions improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 200.0 (index 1982-1984=100) signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases (UNRATE > 4.9%) and decelerating employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%) indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.9% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing boom (HOUST > 2300) combined with strong retail sales (RSAFS > 360000) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 2300 and RSAFS > 360000.
